system_a.summary: Recent reviews (2024–2026) describe a clean, spacious basement apartment with a private entrance and nearby parking, praised for its central location near restaurants and downtown Asheville. Guests frequently mention a comfortable bed, full kitchen, sauna, coffee bar, an honor-system beer and snack fridge, and a responsive, friendly host Brady. Check-in is described as easy. Noise is mixed: several 2025 reviews report hearing little or nothing from the adjoining residence, while two (May 2025 and June 2026) mention upstairs footsteps, described as mild or limited to daytime hours; one guest used headphones. Older, historical reviews (2016–2018) raised more serious concerns, including cleanliness, mildew, bugs, a connecting door to the upstairs, shared laundry access, no TV or temperature control, and thin floors. Those complaints are not repeated in recent reports. Some guests call it dated or budget-oriented, with limited natural light.

system_b.summary: Reviews from 2016–2026 most consistently praise the location: a short, inexpensive ride or roughly 10-minute drive to downtown Asheville, with nearby restaurants. One 2016 guest found it about a mile out, not bike friendly, and Uber costly at peak times. Noise is contested. Many 2025 reviewers heard little from upstairs, though several use near-identical wording and may not be independent. A 2018 guest heard footsteps until past midnight, and a 2026 guest heard them from 7am to 9pm. Privacy concerns, from 2016 and 2018, involved an apparent interior connection to the upstairs home and an unlocked shared laundry room; current status is unknown. Cleanliness is widely praised through 2026, but 2016 reviewers reported filth, bugs and mildew. Beds, kitchen, parking and sauna (2023 onward) are valued; drawbacks include little natural light, a small bathroom and dated furnishings. Host communication is mostly praised, with one 2016 complaint. Current conditions cannot be confirmed.

selected_claims.claim: Location is the most consistently praised feature: close to downtown Asheville (short, cheap rideshare or about a 10-minute drive), with restaurants walkable nearby. One 2016 reviewer found it about a mile out, not bike friendly, and Uber costly at peak times.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praise spans 2016-2026, including recent reviews; the negative view is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Walkability varies by reviewer and destination; downtown itself is generally a short drive or ride away.

selected_claims.claim: Upstairs footsteps are the main contested issue. Many reviewers, including several from 2025, heard little or no noise from the adjoining home. A 2018 reviewer heard every footstep through thin floors until past midnight, and a 2026 reviewer heard footsteps from 7am-9pm. A 2025 reviewer found them mild with a noise machine and called this typical of basements.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints in 2018 and mid-2026; many quiet reports in 2025. Noise may vary by upstairs occupancy.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Several 2025 reviews use near-identical wording, so they may not be independent corroboration. Whether the issue is ongoing cannot be confirmed.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns were raised by a minority. A 2016 reviewer said an interior door or stairway connected to the upstairs house and felt unsafe. A 2018 reviewer found a shared laundry room, accessible to an upstairs tenant, unlocked on arrival. Many others praised the private entrance and parking.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns date from 2016 and 2018; no recent reports in the ledger either way.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Not known whether the access points were later changed or are locked by default; do not treat as currently resolved or present.

selected_claims.claim: Most reviewers describe the area as safe, and one solo female traveler felt safe.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Few reviewers mention it; these are individual perceptions.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is overwhelmingly praised, including in recent reviews. One 2016 reviewer reported filth, bugs, mildew and a gross bed, and another that year reported a mildew-smelling couch.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Severe complaints are from 2016 only; positive reports continue through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No later reports of the 2016 problems, but that does not prove they were fixed.

selected_claims.claim: Comfort is mostly praised, especially the beds and linens, and the space is described as spacious and cozy. Reported drawbacks: a walkout basement with little natural light, a small bathroom, worn or outdated furniture, and (2016) no guest control of heat or cooling. A separate AC unit and fans were provided as of 2019.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed praise spans 2017-2025; the drawbacks are mostly 2016-2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current heating and cooling control is unclear.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities are well regarded: full kitchen, private parking, coffee bar, honor-system snacks and beer, toiletries, and a sauna (mentioned from 2023). Some note there is no TV or cable and that the space is dated or spartan.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sauna reports are 2023-2026; TV complaints are 2016-2019, and a Roku TV was mentioned in 2022.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is described as easy and self-service, with flexible timing and clear instructions. Host communication is widely praised as responsive and accommodating; one 2016 guest found the host brief and unreachable over a weekend.

selected_claims.uncertainty: Possible renovations (2023-2024) may have changed the space.
